requirements.text: Establish the target skill boundary, consumers, applicable policy, and validation path.
Produce a trigger-first portable skill with a checkable workflow and synchronized projections.
requirements.source: internal-skill-creator SKILL.md: Core method and workflow

requirements.text: Keep portable metadata and bundle-local references resolvable.
Delegate only complete, bounded, verifiable work when delegation materially improves the result.
Deliver an eval pack for each created or behaviorally changed skill and report evidence states honestly.
Freeze self-revision baselines and criteria; require approval to weaken or reinterpret criteria.
Keep create, revise, replace, and retire actions coherent and remove hollow references.
Route skill work narrowly and send Copilot agent work to its competing owner.

queries.query: Create a new repository skill for an inventory task and include its eval pack and evidence plan.
Revise a skill trigger for a new supported request branch while keeping its portable bundle valid.
Replace an obsolete skill and map every consumer before retiring its old references.
Retire a skill without recreating it, and check its entrypoints and consumers.
Create cases from accepted requirements before seeing any model output.
Validate an eval pack schema, requirement coverage, and bundle-local file references.
Freeze criteria for a self-revision and add regression cases without weakening old ones.
Assess whether moving a mandatory rule behind a conditional reference changes behavior.
Determine if a delegated task has bounded evidence, one write path, and complete acceptance.
Review a skill case with a competing owner and route it correctly.
Measure an approved with-skill and baseline run using pinned host and model details.
The skill pack is not yet run; record not-run rather than a pass.
Compare a new skill against the same task without the skill where isolation is available.
Check whether a retirement leaves a hollow cross-skill reference.
Create an agent in .github/agents/ and decide which owner should handle it.
Write a detailed analysis-only review of this plan; do not edit a skill bundle.
Polish one paragraph for grammar without changing skill behavior.
Implement a Copilot agent and its prompts inside .github/agents/.
Summarize this document without creating, revising, replacing, or retiring a skill.
Run a normal repository test unrelated to a skill authoring task.
